name: Haruno Mict
source:
"Ah… Th, thank you for being kind to me."
"I, well, I’m okay… Ufu ufufu." 

Position: Soldier
Weapon: String

The youngest of the team, when in battle he controls strings with sharp knives at the end to fight.
Usually his attitude is like a small animal's: he's timid and gets scared easily, but when he feels embarrassed or upset he gets worked up and excitable.
Even he doesn't know what his true personality is.

[Edited from [url=http://cannonette.tumblr.com/post/90317810847/binary-star-main-characters]Cannonette[/url]]
